title: Data Flow: Simplex, Half-Duplex, Full-Duplex
markdown:
Communication between two devices can be **simplex**, **half-duplex**, or **full-duplex**.

1. **Simplex** — Transmission is unidirectional; one station can only transmit and the other can only receive. *Example: Cable TV, keyboard to monitor.*
2. **Half-Duplex** — Each station can both transmit and receive, but **not at the same time**. When one device sends, the other must wait. *Example: Walkie-talkies, police radio.*
3. **Full-Duplex** — Both stations can transmit and receive **simultaneously**. *Example: Telephone network, modern Ethernet.*
